avis.texte: Hands down the best! Worth EVERY cent & I’m not a beauty guru/girly. Just a girl who wants to improve overall skin. It is moisturizing and it feels nice. The glow is nice and its easy to apply. It doesn’t fall off.

avis.titre: Incredible results, just wish it fit better and stayed on
avis.texte: I have been looking into getting face masks for a while and decided on these because of the price, quantity and ingredients. The mask doesn't fit my face properly (too small), is very slippery and didn't stay put until I laid down, even then it kept slipping. The reason I gave this 4 stars is because afterwards my skin felt incredible! My skin was tightened, hydrated and had a glassy look to it. They didn't tear and held up really well, just wish they were slightly bigger. I did notice that my pores were less noticeable, which I love! If you're looking for something that's hassle free, I do not recommend, but if you're looking for good results, get them! I will be keeping these in my rotation.

avis.titre: Absolutely! Makes my face look and feel so fresh, clean and hydrated!
avis.texte: I love this product so much! And make sure to use it every night! It leaves my face feeling super hydrated and leaves my face glowing! It's very easy to use and apply. It feels so good on the face applied. I feel like it is incredibly effective and when you remove it as well, you'll find your face looking and feeling so fresh.

avis.titre: So refreshing after being in the sunSo refreshing after being in the sun
avis.texte: These masks feel incredibly comfortable on my skin, especially after keeping them in the refrigerator. Using one after spending time in the sun feels so cooling and soothing, and my skin feels refreshed and well hydrated afterward. They've become one of my favorite ways to calm my skin at the end of the day.

I LOVE THESE! I probably use around 2-3 a week and have noticed it improving my skincare especially around the time of my period. Definitely recommend these they are so easy to put on and stick easily. Skip the more expensive brands!
SUPER AMAZING . It makes my face feel so young and fresh . I love putting this on after I wash my face . It’s so easy to use .
Glass skin after couple of hours using this mask. It worked great for someone who has sensitive skin like myself. Highly recommended and reasonably priced

These face masks feel really nice & soothing on the skin! The jelly texture is very slippery but smooth and makes my skin feel like it's getting hydrated. It comes in two pieces, along with the extra bits for where the eye and mouth holes are. I ended up putting the extra pieces around my nose since it's been extra dry lately. The two mask pieces are stretchy, but I did find the size to be quite small. It didn't cover my entire forehead and I stretched the mask a bit to fit. I wore this for about 40 minutes, and I was sitting upright, not lying down. Because of gravity, the bottom half of the mask kept slipping down and wanting to leave my face. It didn't, but a good chunk of the middle of my face stayed uncovered. I would have liked to leave this on until it was all absorbed, but I had a child to tend to and it kept peeling off due to gravity. One part of this mask did completely absorb into my skin: the tip of my nose! It actually stuck on pretty good to the tip of my nose, so I can imagine this might be uncomfortable to remove if left on until completely absorbed on the entire face. Overall, it's a fun way to pamper yourself (or for a girl's spa day) and would feel great lying down in a bath or in bed with a book.

These masks are amazing! First off, you get so many in one package for the price, which is a huge plus. I’ve tried a competitor’s brand before, but I actually prefer these so much more. The texture is thinner and smoother, and even with short nails, they didn’t tear or get scratched like others I’ve used…which always bothered me. They are slightly smaller, which I appreciated since I didn’t have the usual overhang. I did trim around the eyes for a more comfortable fit, and I was able to sleep with them on without any issues. In the morning, my skin felt incredibly hydrated and dewy. I also had no irritation or allergic reaction, which is always my biggest concern when trying new skincare products. Even a few days later, my skin still feels soft and looks radiant. I love it. I’ll definitely continue purchasing these over other brands. A must have for anyone who loves skincare and prepping their skin!

avis.titre: Love this set of masks for a fun spa day!
avis.texte: These bio-collagen facial masks are such a nice treat for an at home spa treatment, and they come in a pack of 8 so you can invite over your girlfriends for a fun spa day! The gel mask feels soothing and cooling, making for a relaxing treatment that is easy to do even while doing chores around the house (although I recommend taking the day off to treat yourself!). After using the mask, my skin feels softer, more hydrated, and has a nice glow to it. The masks are effective at making my face feel revitalized and it stay put with no worries about falling off like others I’ve used. I didn’t notice a fragrance to them but my sense of smell is impaired (definitely no bad smells!). Overall, these are a great set of masks to have for regular facial treatments or to share with your friends and family. For the price, this set is a great value for the money too.

I’m a big fan of this style mask so I’ve tried quite a few over the years. It has a light, not overpowering fragrance and left my skin feeling well moisturized. The 8-pack is a great value but I do wish the boxes were easier to separate without ripping the boxes so the multiple packs could be gifted. The major takeaways for me are that they didn’t irritate my sensitive skin, left my skin with a ‘glow’ for several days after each use as well as feeling much softer and well moisturized, and were much easier to put on than most because of the two piece design.

What a great deal for probably the coolest face mask I have ever tried! I am middle aged and have eczema, acne and obviously wrinkles ha! Most of the time when I try new skincare items they immediately burn my sensitive skin or cause a rash within minutes. Not this bada** mask. It’s like a magic trick! 🪄 You put it on, smooth it over your skin, sit back, relax and it vanishes! That’s how you know it’s time to remove. It disappears and feels taut on your skin. Then you just move your face a bit to loosen and peel it off revealing hydrated skin. It didn’t reach to the top of my forehead or around my nose so I tore the mask a little to make it fit better and used the eye and nose pieces to fill in the gaps. I do wish this came in a long face/big forehead size. I can feel how dry my skin is where the mask was not. I left it on for about an hour while I took some me time, listening to my book and sipping spa water. Ahhhh This is just so cool I’ll be sharing with my sisters so they can try it. It really works and it’s really affordable.

In the beginning I felt a bit itchy feeling. I didn’t think about it much. Very jello-y or slimy to go on. Slips out of your hands. It is white once on then turns clear after 2 hours. It felt hard or stiff once dry. It felt good going on but when you peel it off felt like a nose strip being peeled off. My skin feels sticky, I thought I would feel moisturized or like new. No. Sadly disappointed. Skin feels like I need to wash it out now. But if have sensitive skin this might not be for you.

- Bio-Collagen Facial Mask - 2 Pack total of 8 masks - Regular size - Cooling effect immediately - Moistures and hydrates skin - Hydrogel Face Mask - Regular self care essential for me - Overnight Collagen Face Mask for Glass Skin for special occasions

I ordered these as a fun activity for the women in my family when we have get-togethers. We like to do jigsaw puzzles, diamond art, play card games, and then do a few beauty rituals, like polishing nails. I thought that doing a facial mask together would be a lot of fun and also yield some great photos. These are nice and pliable, easy to use, and in the trial run, left my skin feeling soft and clean. They are of a high-quality and I would buy them again!

avis.titre: A hydrating face mask and easy to put on.
avis.texte: I received these collagen face masks and I'm happy with them. Get a bunch for the price, 8 masks total. They fit my face well and feel really soothing. it did slide around a bit but stayed on and I could reposition it easily to fit well. They're super hydrating and left my skin feeling smooth. Love that they're made with nice ingredients like centella asiatica and green tea extracts. For $9.99, it's a great deal.

I wear face masks about ~3 times per week and sometimes have issues with the jelly masks like these that fall/slip down my face. At first the bottom piece started slipping down right after application, but after readjusting once, both pieces stayed in place for the duration of the 20 minutes I wore it (mask recommended 30-40min application, but I felt the mask was finished where my under eyes were starting to get dry as the eye slits usually don't cover my under eyes. The mask is white and has a removeable film. The mask itself is white. The scent is nothing at all. It has a little extra liquid in the pouch afterwards, but only enough for my neck area. Made in Korea.

At this price point I truly wasn’t expecting much, but they aren’t bad. Not the best mask I’ve used, but not the worst either. They do dry to a more translucent opacity, but give yourself about 30 minutes if you have a hard time seeing the difference. (See photos) When it’s done and you take it off, you don’t get that same moisturized feel you get from higher quality masks. It’s not dry, you can feel how soft your skin is when you touch it. My skin feels tighter and a bit more evenly toned with a slight sheen. I do put a moisturizer on after, but I’m not sure it’s needed. For the amount you get and the price you pay, these are surprisingly pretty good masks.
